newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIU SHARE DEAL REACHED - SWEDBANK.
newsitem.headline: HOIU SHARE DEAL REACHED - SWEDBANK.

text.p: Sweden's Swedbank said on Thursday that it had reached an agreement with Estonia's central bank paving the way for it acquire a 7.4 percent stake in Hoiupank .
"The parties have reached an agreement and it is expected to be signed on Monday", Swedbank executive vice-president Lars-Olof Odlund told Reuters.
Odlund said the parties have agreed on the price but added that it will not be made public.
When the deal is completed, Swedbank will be the single largest owner in Hoiupank with a total of 19.9 percent of the shares.
The Estonian central bank will reduce its stake from 13.6 percent to 6.2 percent.
Hoiupank is Estonia's second largest bank.
Swedbank said on Wednesday that an increased stake in Hoiupank was in line with its strategy to enhance cooperation and partnership in Nordic and Baltic markets.
